Specification: This module contains a PlusCal algorithm named flags embedded in a comment. It declares variables flags \in [1..3 -> BOOLEAN] and next = TRUE. The algorithm repeatedly executes while next do with f \in DOMAIN flags, n \in BOOLEAN do flags[f] := ~flags[f]; next := n; end with; end while.
